channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Policy support tempers depreciation risk – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) kept its policy rate at 5.25% with a neutral stance, in line with most expectations. Indian Rupee (INR) outperformed after authorities unveiled measures to attract foreign capital and tax exemptions for investors.

item.title: Euro: Three paths to higher levels against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Pfister at Commerzbank outlines three scenarios for higher EUR/USD in coming weeks. The pair has retreated towards 1.16 as markets cut European Central Bank (ECB) hike expectations from four moves to about 70 bps.

item.title: US Dollar: Jobs data keeps upside risk – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes the US Dollar (USD) is trading near the top of its recent range as markets await key United States (US) labour data, with EUR/USD seen vulnerable to a stronger Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD languishes below $4,480 with US Nonfarn Payrolls on tap
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) nurses moderate losses on Friday, trading just above $4,460 at the time of writing, after failing to confirm a move above $4,500 on Thursday.

item.title: Nonfarm Payrolls expected to highlight US labor market strength extended into May
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for May on Friday at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Canada Unemployment Rate expected to remain at 6.9% in May
item.description: Statistics Canada will release its Labour Force Survey on Friday, and markets are bracing for quite a steady print. The Unemployment Rate is expected to remain at 6.9% in May, while the Net Change in Employment is forecast to increase by 10K, reversing April’s 17.7K drop.

item.title: India’s Q1 Gross Domestic Product expands beyond expectations: What it means for Indian Rupee
item.description: India’s Q1 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data rises at a steady pace of 7.8% Year-on-Year (YoY), faster than estimates of 7.2%.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Consolidates near 160.00 as US NFP takes centre stage
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades in a tight range around 160.00 during the European trading session on Friday. The pair wobbles as investors await the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for May, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Gold edges lower on Middle East tensions ahead of key US employment report
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades around $4,463 on Friday at the time of writing, down 0.26% on the day, as investors reduce exposure ahead of the release of the US May employment report.

item.title: US Dollar: Payrolls eyed for dovish reaction – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Global Strategy Team highlights a bull-steepening in US rates as Oil fell and geopolitical headlines hit sentiment.

item.title: Euro appreciates against US Dollar despite downbeat Eurozone GDP data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is going through a solid recovery against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, reaching levels a few pips shy of 1.1650 at the time of writing.

item.title: Indian Rupee surges as RBI unveils measures to boost foreign investment
item.description: The Indian Rupee gains against the US Dollar (USD) after the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) monetary policy decision, with the USD/INR pair sliding to near 95.00.

item.title: Equities: Rotation risks build into June rebalancing – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage notes that both retail and institutional investors bought the April weakness in US equities, but momentum has faded and exposure to energy and technology is elevated.

item.title: Why is the Indonesian Rupiah hitting historic lows when it's already deeply undervalued?
item.description: The Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) has dropped to a historic low, crossing the psychological threshold of 18,000 per US Dollar alongside a sharp multi-year contraction in domestic equity markets.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $72.87 per troy ounce, down 1.37% from the $73.89 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: United States: Growth holds as inflation surprises – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Bank’s Danske Research Team notes that US economic growth slowed at the start of 2026 but has remained more resilient than expected despite the war in Iran.

item.title: Brent: Lower prices ease inflation fears – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that Brent Oil has reversed recent gains as hopes grow for a US-Iran deal, easing stagflation concerns and pulling inflation expectations lower. They note declines in both spot and 6‑month Brent futures alongside softer US and Euro inflation swaps.

item.title: Iron: Australia weighs response to China monopsony – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton highlights moves by Australia’s iron ore majors to counter China’s growing monopsony power in the iron ore trade.

item.title: US Dollar: Jobs data keeps bullish momentum – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole highlights that limited upside volatility in Oil, despite stalled US-Iran talks, is capping further Dollar gains even as the macro backdrop improves and Fed expectations turn more hawkish.

item.title: Oil: Elevated prices sustain inflation spillovers – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts argue that persistent geopolitical tensions in the Persian Gulf will keep Oil near $100, with restricted Strait of Hormuz traffic driving volatility.

item.title: Swiss Franc appreciates against US Dollar as traders await US Nonfarm Payrolls data
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) extends gains against the US Dollar (USD) for the second consecutive day on Friday, with the USD/CHF pair hitting session lows at 0.7872 so far, down from nearly two-month highs at 0.7927 earlier in the week.The Swissie is drawing some support from a moderate US Dollar weakness

item.title: United States: Consumers watch jobs as savings shrink – UBS
item.description: UBS' Chief Economist Paul Donovan discusses how the latest US employment report may offer a weak and unreliable signal on the labor market, with expectations for flat unemployment and sub-100,000 payrolls.

item.title: British Pound: Labour softness tempers BoE hikes – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny highlights growing signs of United Kingdom (UK) labour market weakness, including a sharp HMRC jobs drop and elevated HR1 redundancy notifications, which could influence Bank of England (BoE) policy.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Trades lower around 99.30 ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades lower against its major currency peers during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Consolidation inside tight range versus US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann now see USD/JPY in a neutral, range-trading phase after earlier upside momentum faded.

item.title: Forex Today: Focus shifts to Nonfarm Payrolls as Middle East tensions remain high
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, June 5:

item.title: S&P 500: Tech wobble but breadth improves – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank analysts describe a mixed backdrop for US equities, with the S&P 500 rebounding on broad participation even as chipmakers lag after Broadcom’s disappointing AI guidance.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecasts: Pound returns above 215.00 amid broad-based Yen weakness
item.description: The Japanese Yen’s (JPY) mild recovery attempt seen during Friday’s Asian session has been short-lived.

item.title: Oil: Prices stay subdued despite Hormuz risk – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton stresses that Oil markets remain in focus as Brent futures fell sharply even with the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed in their baseline.

item.title: Neither inflation nor the RBA: What's actually driving the Australian Dollar lower
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is navigating rough waters, in the stark divergence between persistent domestic inflation and slowing economic growth.
